hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Find all occurrence start indices of pattern a in s.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Find all occurrence start indices of pattern b in s.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For each index i where a occurs, use binary search on b's indices to test if there exists some j with |i - j| <= k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Pattern search followed by binary search proximity verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops checking every pair takes O(|a_idx| * |b_idx|).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use binary search or two pointers to check proximity in sorted index lists.
